title: Distributed tracing across services

kcs.statement: Distributed tracing propagates a trace id through every service call, and each hop records a span with its timings, so you can see which service made a request slow.

problem_ideas: Given five spans with start and end times, find the service on the critical path
Where is the trace id created and how is it passed over HTTP and a message queue?
Sampling 1% of traces at 100,000 req/s: how many traces per second are stored?
Why can't per-service logs alone explain a slow checkout across 6 services?
A span shows 300 ms in a queue before a worker starts: what does that point to?
Join a trace with logs: which field makes it possible?
